questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: 'He said that he (have) seen the film before.'
Select the option that correctly reports the following statement: 'I think that climate change is a serious problem.'
options: She said that she thinks that climate change is a serious problem.
She said that she thought that climate change was a serious problem.
She said that she thinks that climate change was a serious problem.
She said that she thought that climate change is a serious problem.
questions.answer: She said that she thought that climate change was a serious problem.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice to report the information? 'The committee announced that the meeting would be postponed.'
options: It was announced by the committee that the meeting would be postponed.
The announcement was that the meeting would be postponed by the committee.
The meeting was announced to be postponed by the committee.
It was announced that the meeting would be postponed.
questions.answer: It was announced by the committee that the meeting would be postponed.
